payload.entry: Implemented the snapshot-only task-move planner under src/native/task_move/{mod,plan,tests}.rs. Public-to-crate interface: crate::native::task_move::{load_vault_snapshot, plan_task_move, MovePlan, MoveRequest, MoveSelector, PlanError, VaultSnapshot} plus crate::native::task_move::plan::{MoveRecord, RenameRecord, RepairedFile, TaskCandidate}. Temporary unused-code gate: #[cfg(test)] mod task_move in src/native.rs until bob-cli-9y.1.1.2 wires production dispatch; nested types are reachable via pub(crate) mod plan. Reused collect_done helpers (task_block_end, next_available_block_id with reserved co-moved ids, NoteIndex/MovedBlockTargets/repair_links_in_note) via pub(crate) re-exports; archive behavior unchanged. Verified cargo test --lib native::task_move (23 passed) and native::collect_done (69 passed), cargo fmt --all -- --check, and cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D unused -A unused_extern_crates -A unused_macro_rules -D private_interfaces. No --epic-symbol leftovers. Did not add bob task move CLI.
